gui_forms::TabControl.summary: TabControl owns TabPage lifetime, selection, active-page attachment, per-page focus restoration, pointer and keyboard traversal, four header alignments, three appearances, inspectable geometry, and semantic virtual tabs.
remarks: Owns `TabPage` lifetime and selection; only the active page is attached, and per-page focus is restored on reselection.
Supports pointer and keyboard traversal, four header alignments, three appearances, inspectable geometry, and tab semantics.
gui_forms::TabControl.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::TabControl.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::TabControl.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
